messages:
olivia: FYI after the VPC egress default-deny + new keystore IAM condition, warm-pool GPU nodes in us-west-2 started failing KMS decrypts and not joining (~40% drop).

olivia: sample log:
```
ERROR keystore.decrypt node=node-wp-07 status=403 grant=gr-7788 via_service=false
WARN warmup.join node=node-wp-07 reason="keystore timeout"
```

raj: that matches the iam rollout note (kms:ViaService). likely failing because privatelink proxy removes the header. any quick mitigations?

maria: cost tradeoff: temporary NAT/allowlist will add NAT GW + logging costs ~ $1.5k-$2.5k/day region-wide. we can approve short TTL.

liam: two options: 1) temp firewall allowlist for keystore privatelink ENIs (fast), 2) revert the iam condition scoped to warm-pool grants (safer long term, needs sec approval). prefer 1 for immediate recovery.

ben: confirmed the condition is `StringEquals: { "kms:ViaService": "keystore.amazonaws.com" }`. proxied requests are evaluated without that field. removing it restores decrypts.

raj: I'll open a short TTL fw-CR and add allowlist ipset for the privatelink subnets. will tag TTL=120m and add audit label.

ops-bot: INC-8420 created for warm-pool join failures. Linked FW-CR 5951. Estimated cost impact $1.9k/day. Escalate to security@redwood if TTL > 4h.

ben: opening PR to remove the ViaService condition but scoping to grants [gr-7788,gr-7789] to limit blast radius. will request sec review.

liam: plan: raj applies fw allowlist (0-30m), verify joins (30-90m), ben merges scoped PR (1-2h), then remove fw exception.

olivia: assign: raj=apply fw-CR, liam=monitor metrics, ben=draft PR, maria=approve short-term cost, olivia=postmortem.

raj: FW-CR 5951 applied to staging for canary. warming looks normal after exception. applying to prod now.

liam: prod joins recovered to ~96% after fw change. continue monitoring.

ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/7240 (scoped revert). sec review requested.

olivia: good work. please capture follow-ups: add unit test for grant path via privatelink, gating for keystore grant rollouts, and an automated warm-pool canary metric. closing thread after PR merge + fw removal.
